risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively specific and well quantified, including revenue, orders, backlog, cancellations, book-to-bill, margins, and cash balances. Risk tone is moderately negative because of severe LED/MOCVD oversupply, sharply reduced orders, backlog contraction, and a forecasted 38–48% revenue decline in 2012. Promotional product language and standard forward-looking-statement disclaimers add limited boilerplate but do not materially obscure the core risks.
